essence: Thus prepared, the supreme teacher is qualified to perform the subsequent rites.
The teacher’s external adornment and inner satisfaction mark his proper ritual condition.
The ritual requires the presence of duly satisfied ritual specialists and attendants.
Worship of the fire and the final offering must be completed according to the proper sequence.
The image’s placement after the fire rite allows two prescribed locations.
